title: Indigo Ledger: clients' payroll data copied
sector: IT services (payroll processing for client companies)
types: Unauthorised access of IT systems or data
Attack affecting cloud computing systems, servers, software or applications
must: Say how they got in: the VPN account.
Say which cloud storage was read.
Say what you have done so far.

inbox.subject: Are our employees affected?
inbox.body: We are an RBI-regulated bank. Our staff payroll is with you. We need facts within the hour to meet our own six-hour reporting duty.

inbox.subject: Logs requested
inbox.body: Please preserve VPN, server and cloud logs for 180 days and share the indicators in STIX or CSV.
